ValidationRule.description: 16/10/2026: Lead tao qua API phai co email dung dinh dang (khong dau cach, co @ va ten mien). Khoang trang dau/cuoi da duoc APICreateLead xoa truoc khi insert.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), isAPI__c, OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Email)), NOT(REGEX(Email, "^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Email_check__c)), NOT(REGEX(Email_check__c, "^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"))) ) )
